intro: A cloaked figure has set up a small counter in the shade. The sign reads: GENES BOUGHT & SOLD. NO REFUNDS.
speaker: Ability Broker
introDialogue: Ah, a customer with inventory. I deal in potential, friend — the talents Pokémon are born with but never show.$My stock all comes with their hidden gifts... awake. The price is two of yours. Any two. Final sale.
title: The Ability Broker
description: Trade away TWO of your party members — permanently — and the broker hands you a random Pokémon with its HIDDEN ABILITY already active. The quality of the merchandise scales with what you give up.

1.label: Trade Two Pokémon
1.tooltip:
(+) Receive a random Pokémon with its Hidden Ability active (scales with what you trade)
(-) Two party members, gone forever
1.selected: Pleasure doing business. Don't ask where they go. You wouldn't believe me anyway.

2.label: Keep Your Team
2.selected: Sentiment! Terrible for business, wonderful for the soul. Off you go.

outro: The broker's counter folds itself into a briefcase. By the time you blink, there's nothing in the shade at all.
